decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API builds directly on the firm's own messaging cloud and API expertise, so in-house R&D can read its two years of presence on the market and refine it at low cost.

The email-to-SMS gateway extends the firm's core email and messaging infrastructure, which gives it strong absorptive capacity to assimilate early customer feedback and to integrate the gateway into its multichannel platform.

The SMS-to-email gateway complements Product B and relies on the same self-developed technology, so the firm can interpret its early results and improve it within existing knowledge without a separate resource burden.
